column5: This leads to an actual conference.

column4: 大将軍ピサロは来てなかったが、４名の魔物将軍と魔人レイ、そしてコンバート
column5: Great General Pizarro was not present, but four Monster Generals, the Fiend Lei, and Convert were there.

column4: ランスは彼らに会う前にカオスだけは預からせて欲しいと言われたので預けている（ただし偽者）
column5: Before meeting them, Rance was asked to entrust only Chaos, so he did (however, it was a fake).

column4: ここで向こうも信じ切って対談しようとしてくるが、ランスはがははと裏切り斬りかかる
column5: At this point, they fully trust and try to negotiate, but Rance laughs and betrays them with a slash.

column4: 最初にレイに斬りつけ重傷を負わす
column5: He first slashes Lei, inflicting a serious wound.

column4: 屋敷の給仕をしていた者はほとんどが先に進入していたランスの部下達
column5: Most of those serving in the mansion were Rance's subordinates who had entered earlier.

column5: They kill the four Monster Generals and corner the Fiend Lei.
